notes: Stage keyboard/synthesizer (organ/piano/synth layers), not a traditional AV signal-chain device — closest category/type mapping is "audio"/"Other" since no "Keyboard/Instrument" type exists in the taxonomy. Available in three physical variants (88-key, 73-key, Compact 73-key semi-weighted) with identical rear-panel I/O; dimensions/weight differ but connections do not, so rackUnits is omitted (desktop/stage keyboard, not rack-mountable). The 4 main audio outputs are stated by Nord as "unbalanced" 1/4" jacks, which was interpreted as TS (ts-6.35) rather than TRS since the spec explicitly calls them unbalanced (mono) — Nord's own text does not use the word "TRS" for these, unlike the Organ Swell and Control Pedal jacks which are explicitly stated as TRS stereo. The Triple Pedal jack is a 5-pin DIN connector but carries proprietary continuous-pedal data, not MIDI — connector id "midi-din" was used as the closest physical match (same connector shell), noted here since it is not actually a MIDI port. No grade could be confirmed for the USB Type-B port (Nord does not state USB spec/speed) or for any other connector, so grade was omitted throughout per instructions. Source verified over HTTPS with a valid certificate (nordkeyboards.com official specifications page); output-numbering (Output 1-4) cross-confirmed via Nord User Forum threads discussing the rear panel.

ports.name: Sustain Pedal
ports.note: Compatible with Nord Sustain Pedal 2 (continuous sensor), Nord Triple Pedal 1, and switch-type pedals

ports.name: Triple Pedal
ports.note: 5-pin DIN connector for Nord Triple Pedal 2; carries proprietary pedal data, not MIDI, but uses the same 5-pin DIN shell

ports.name: Rotor Pedal
ports.note: Momentary or switch-type pedal for rotary speaker speed control

ports.name: Foot Switch
ports.note: Accepts a momentary two-button pedal or a single switch-type pedal

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Type B connector for USB MIDI, software update, and Sound Manager (patch/sample) transfer; USB spec/speed not stated by manufacturer

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC C14 inlet; Nord specifies the included power cord's connector as IEC C14
